description: Get the CELPass answer template for one CELPIP task: Speaking Tasks 1–8 (each step with its seconds and a sentence starter) or Writing Tasks 1–2 (each paragraph with its length and a starter). Leave out `task` to list all ten. Tell the learner to change the starters into their own words rather than memorising them, and link them to the builder URL to make their own version and try it on a timed question.
name: get_celpip_template
title: CELPIP answer template
